_comment: Reference values for ltem-invertebrate-abundance skill at Cabo Pulmo. Used for validation — output must be within tolerance. Four focal taxa: Echinoidea, Asteroidea, Holaxonia, Scleractinia.
_units: individuals per transect (ind./transect). Each transect is 25m × 2m = 50 m².

Echinoidea.ecological_role: Reef grazers. Control algal growth. At high density can cause destructive grazing (urchin barrens). At Cabo Pulmo, kept in balance by predators.

kpi_mean_abundance_per_transect.description: Mean sea urchin abundance per transect. Values 5–20 ind./transect are typical for healthy Pacific Mexico reefs. High values (>30) may indicate predator depletion.

Echinoidea.notes: Echinoidea abundance at Cabo Pulmo shows interannual variability — no strong directional trend expected.

Asteroidea.ecological_role: Mesopredators. Predators of bivalves and urchins. Sensitive to disease (sea star wasting syndrome affected Pacific populations ~2013–2016). Indicator of food web integrity.

kpi_mean_abundance_per_transect.description: Mean sea star abundance per transect. Asteroidea are naturally low-density; values 1–5 ind./transect are typical.

Asteroidea.notes: Sea star populations are sensitive to disease events. Accept high variability.

Holaxonia.ecological_role: Structural habitat builders. Provide shelter for fish and invertebrates. Sensitive to thermal stress and sedimentation. Long-lived (decades to centuries).

kpi_mean_abundance_per_transect.description: Mean gorgonian colony count per transect. Cabo Pulmo supports notable gorgonian populations — values 5–15 colonies/transect are plausible for this site.

Holaxonia.notes: Holaxonia at Cabo Pulmo expected stable or slightly increasing with continued protection.

Scleractinia.ecological_role: Reef builders. The calcium carbonate skeleton forms the physical reef structure. Cover and abundance are key indicators of reef health. Bleach under thermal stress.

kpi_mean_abundance_per_transect.description: Mean stony coral colony count per transect. Cabo Pulmo is at the poleward range edge of tropical coral reefs — naturally lower coral cover than Caribbean or tropical Pacific sites.

Scleractinia.notes: Scleractinia are sensitive to bleaching events. High interannual variability expected. Cabo Pulmo experienced bleaching events in 2015 and 2023 — expect dips in those years.

aggregation_note: These are region-level means (all reefs in the Cabo Pulmo LTEM region averaged). Individual reef values vary considerably. Transect = 25m × 2m band. Abundance = sum of individuals per transect, then averaged across transects per reef, then averaged across reefs per region-year.
